title: Scoped navigation search
responsibility: Accepts search entries only for the currently displayed revision and validates result destinations.

inputs.name: navbarSearch.scope
inputs.description: Resolved explorer scope, or null while unavailable.

inputs.name: navbarSearch.given
inputs.description: Entries for the displayed revision, null/undefined while loading.

outputs.name: navbarSearch
outputs.description: Accepted entries only when a location exists and every entry matches its commit, plus a scope label and destination resolver. Destinations require matching commit, category and identifier in the accepted set, and preserve the displayed branch/revision mode.
